posts.author: mendel k
posts.headline: Talent Acquisition @ HireMe
posts.text: Skip the ATS. Connect directly. For new grads, interns, and career changers, applying online can feel like shouting into a void. Your resume might never reach a human. What if you could find the exact person hiring for your dream junior tech role and connect with them before you even apply? Here's a LinkedIn hack to do just that: 1. Go to LinkedIn's search bar. 2. Type "Recruiter" or "Hiring Manager." 3. Click "All Filters." 4. Under "Keywords," add: "junior software engineer" (or your role) AND your tech stack (e.g., "Python" or "React"). 5. Apply "Location" (your target US city/state) and "Industry." 6. Filter by "People." Now you see relevant recruiters. Next, send a personalized connection request. Don't just hit connect. Mention a specific company project you admire, a recent post of theirs, or a shared connection. Briefly state your interest in junior roles and your key skill. Example: "Hi [Name], I saw your post about [Company X]'s new project. As a new grad interested in Python/data roles, I'd love to connect." This direct approach bypasses the application black hole. You build a real connection and stand out. HireMe helps you find junior roles. This helps you get noticed for them. Who will you connect with first today? #JuniorTech #JobSearchHack #LinkedInTips #NewGrad
